## LmdbSchema.useVersions property

Optional `useVersions` flag for the underlying sub-DB.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static useVersions?: boolean;
```

## Remarks

Enable optimistic locking via LMDB record versions on this collection — `env.rootPut(id, value, version, ifVersion)` and `env.rootGetEntry(id)` require it. Defaults to the env's `useVersions` when omitted.
